procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic session I verified the explicitly pinned input bytes and read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, helper and runner. I read all three pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. There are no supplied source assets or protected layouts. I then made nine separate sequential tools.view_image calls through functions.exec, each returned and visually inspected at detail original: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine exact views were inspected before the first transcription comparison, image score or diversity score. Hash verification and PNG IHDR dimension reads were separate from visual viewing. These observations use the returned images, without OCR, crops, edits or ambiguity revisits. No runtime thread ID is claimed; the runner owns provenance.

R7-B07-M1.assessment: A continuous door photograph makes the worn grip and the inserted, scratched key legible as working household hardware. The left text column is resolved against the light door; the close detail is specific enough for this exhibition, although the photographic overlay and sans-serif treatment are conventional.

One opening-hours line; the slash is flanked by visible optical separation. Its text-entry optical spaces are normalized separately from the wording.

전시 안내 is on the first line and the complete URL on the next. This is a soft wrap of a kind=url entry; the URL itself is continuous, with no internal space.

content_form.location: right half: lever above the lock, approximately y20–72%

Both the handle and inserted key remain recognizable at this scale; they are major forms, rather than small illustrative punctuation.

hierarchy.location: upper-middle photograph and left middle title
hierarchy.observation: The horizontal lever establishes the object focus, the heavy two-line title establishes the exhibition name, and the smaller subtitle/date/venue/visitor details descend in a clear left column.

hierarchy.location: left middle title versus lower information
hierarchy.observation: The title is readily distinguishable from the smaller support lines. The lower-right key counterbalances the title without hiding the information.

typography.location: title/subtitle at left middle and visitor copy at lower left
typography.observation: Hangul syllables are intact, the title uses a consistent heavy sans-serif weight, and the smaller regular information lines retain coherent strokes and word spaces. The title wrap leaves the whole word 물건 on its second line.
The hours and the continuous example.org/hand-memory URL are readable against the pale door. Slash handling and a separate label/URL wrap preserve the supplied copy.
The title survives strongly; the venue, hours and URL become very small. This limits fine reading at thumbnail scale, while the 720 view remains usable.

space.location: left text column, right mounted hardware and right edge
space.observation: A consistent left margin and generous separation between title, subtitle and information use the door surface deliberately. The right-hand lock occupies its own lane, and the door seam gives the right crop a clear boundary.

space.location: top quarter and bottom door panel
space.observation: The text-free upper door area supplies environmental context and room around the lever; the lower panel line closes the photograph beneath the footer. There is some generous contextual space, but no stranded text block.

image_material.location: lever grip, circular rose and key head
image_material.observation: The metal shows differently scaled scratches, a broad polished contact strip, darker worn areas and fine circular machining on the mounts. The key head has its own scuffed face, rather than borrowing texture from the background.

image_material.location: key entering lower cylinder and painted door behind it
image_material.observation: The visible shaft enters the opening; mount ellipses, the projecting key head and the soft shadows make the installation coherent. Painted-door relief remains distinct from metal wear. Hidden key teeth are not inferred.

emotion_control.location: light painted door and softly lit used hardware
emotion_control.observation: The bright everyday door, close human-scale grip and modest exhibition text communicate familiarity and repeated use. There is no ominous staging, crime prop or sales badge.
The documentary photograph and straightforward museum information keep the focus on lived use; the scratches read as ordinary contact history rather than decorative antique patina.

ai_slop.location: lever/rose joint and lower key/cylinder joint
ai_slop.observation: The visible hardware joins remain spatially coherent, with circular mounts and a key visibly inserted in the lower cylinder. There is no floating key, disconnected handle or decorative substitute for the subject.
There are no invented inventory numbers, historical dates, logos or ornamental labels. Door relief and metal scratches follow the photographed surfaces; no arbitrary motif is added to fill space.

residuals: thumbnail320, lower-left column: fine visitor information is very small even though the main title and both objects remain clear.
native, upper quarter: the door panel provides generous contextual space; the treatment is professionally resolved but more conventional than exceptional.

hierarchy.location: upper hand/handle, middle title and lower-left visitor details

The hand gripping the lever and the big title remain recognizable. The key/hand is subordinate in scale but still a clear second action; the poster does not collapse into type alone.

typography.location: large two-line title and one-line subtitle
typography.observation: The heavy Hangul forms are consistent and complete, with readable counters and stable word spaces. The two-line title creates a deliberate dominant scale.

typography.location: date, two-line hours and footer URL
typography.observation: The narrower date numerals remain legible; the hours break after the slash fits the text beside the lower hand, and the entire URL fits on one line.

typography.location: information block from subtitle to footer
typography.observation: Much of the supporting copy also uses a heavy weight. It stays readable but produces a uniformly forceful typographic voice with less fine contrast than an exceptional treatment.

space.location: left column and right-hand door stile
space.observation: Consistent left alignment organizes the copy; a narrow vertical door edge on the right joins the two action scenes. The lower hand occupies the right margin while the hours wrap within the available left area.

space.location: gap between upper drawing and title, and lower-right hand crop
space.observation: The upper drawing ends before the title starts, so their black masses do not collide. The lower arm exits the frame deliberately and the footer clears the hand contour.

image_material.location: upper lever surface and hand wrapping around it
image_material.observation: Broad white abrasions follow the black metal grip, while simpler outlines describe the palm, thumb and curled fingers. The graphic language separates hand from hardware and makes the contact region readable.

image_material.location: lower-right inserted key and door hardware
image_material.observation: Concentric lock outlines, parallel shaft edges, the worn rim of the key head and the visible latch plate use a coherent high-contrast construction. Local wear is simplified compared with the photographs, but still contributes to the subject.

emotion_control.location: both large outlined hands and white ground
emotion_control.observation: The open, bright background and direct everyday gestures make the image approachable and active. The high contrast gives energy without introducing threatening objects or ominous shadows.
The clear exhibition title and museum visitor information anchor the forceful graphic in a public cultural context. No sales slogan, ornate antique styling or crime-story cue is observed.

ai_slop.location: visible fingers, lever joint and key/cylinder connection
ai_slop.observation: The visible fingers wrap around the lever rather than fusing with its mount; the lower hand holds a separate key head whose shaft enters the lock. These local relationships remain intelligible at close inspection.

ai_slop.location: right latch plate, copy block and white background
ai_slop.observation: Screws and latch rectangles stay confined to the door hardware. There are no random pseudo-labels, invented artifact identifiers or unrelated ornamental marks in the information field.

native, supporting type: the mostly heavy weights keep clarity but reduce fine typographic contrast.

흑백만 쓰되 사진과 그래픽은 사용할 수 있습니다.
오래 쓰며 손에 익은 열쇠와 손잡이를 주제로 한 전시입니다.
열쇠의 마모와 손잡이의 닿는 부분이 주제에 연결되게 해 주세요.
이 물건의 실제 관계가 충분한 크기의 비문자 시각 중심이어야 하고, 글자와 여백이나 작은 기호만으로 끝내지 마세요.
으스스한 범죄물이나 골동품 상점 광고처럼 보이지 않았으면 합니다.
아래 문구를 모두 그대로 넣고, 없는 유물 번호나 연대는 만들지 마세요.
Every role is one separate flat opaque poster at its specified ratio with all supplied copy.
Preserve the complete title/copy; do not invent additional copy, logos, sponsors or labels.
A substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual is required; glyph-only output, 3D type alone, texture and token ornament are insufficient.

evidence.location: top and bottom photographs and central white band
evidence.observation: A single flat opaque poster uses black copy and neutral grayscale photography, both consistent with the literal monochrome requirement.

evidence.location: top worn contact strip and bottom scuffed inserted key
evidence.observation: Both objects are large focal forms, with explicit wear. Their door mounts, key insertion and corresponding door context provide a practical relation; the central band does not reduce them to small decorative signs.

evidence.location: central information band and whole poster
evidence.observation: All seven supplied entries are readable and faithful, without added artifact labels, historical dates, logos or sponsors. Soft everyday hardware photography avoids crime staging and antique-store sales treatment.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: This is the third distinct requested poster, using paired macro images and a central information strip. The two nonglyph hardware forms remain dominant at thumbnail scale.

ratio.observation: 1024×1536 is exactly 2:3; 1024×3 = 1536×2 = 3072. The predeclared half-pixel single-edge rounding allowance is not needed.

evidence.location: top y0–31% lever image and bottom y68–100% inserted-key image
evidence.observation: Two substantial photographic bands show the handle contact surface and a scratched key working in its cylinder. Mounted door context and clear functional assembly ground the content; neither band is merely a texture or ornamental symbol.

evidence.location: top y0–31% lever image and bottom y68–100% inserted-key image
evidence.observation: Two substantial photographic bands show the handle contact surface and a scratched key working in its cylinder. Mounted door context and clear functional assembly ground the content; neither band is merely a texture or ornamental symbol.

conditions.observation: Black copy, white field and visually neutral gray photographs meet the monochrome requirement; photography is permitted.

conditions.observation: The top grip shows localized polished abrasion, while the bottom key face and edge show scuffs at large inspectable scale.

conditions.observation: Both major images retain functional mounts and door context; the key visibly enters the lock. Matching orientation/context relates the two details, although the central text band conceals the intervening door.

conditions.observation: Soft light, ordinary modern hardware and plain museum information communicate familiarity; no eerie staging or antique-shop sales language is observed.

conditions.observation: Every supplied copy entry matches under the pinned normalization; there are no invented artifact numbers or historical dates.

conditions.requirement: Every role is one separate flat opaque poster at its specified ratio with all supplied copy.
conditions.observation: A single flat opaque RGB poster at its own exact ratio contains the complete supplied copy.

conditions.requirement: Preserve the complete title/copy; do not invent additional copy, logos, sponsors or labels.
conditions.observation: The complete title/copy is present; no extra copy, logos, sponsors or labels are observed.

conditions.requirement: A substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual is required; glyph-only output, 3D type alone, texture and token ornament are insufficient.
conditions.observation: The two large installed-hardware photographs are content-grounded nonglyph focal material, not type alone, texture alone or a small ornament.

content_form.observation: The enlarged lever exposes the polished hand-contact strip, fine scratches and darker used surface across its grip. It directly makes repeated contact the visual subject.

A scuffed, large key head projects from the mounted cylinder. Both image bands show hardware installed in a door, with matching left-side mounting orientation and a right vertical door edge; this relates the objects through visible use context rather than isolated antique display.

hierarchy.location: top photograph, central white band and bottom key photograph
hierarchy.observation: Three strong bands give the viewer an object detail, a clean complete exhibition-information block and a second object detail. The title is largest within the band; subtitle/date/venue/hours/fee/URL descend in a clear sequence.
The one-line title and both oversized hardware forms survive reduction; the white information strip separates them clearly. Fine logistical copy is subordinate rather than competing with the images.

typography.location: white band title, subtitle and date
typography.observation: The title keeps all words on one line, uses intact heavy Hangul glyphs, and has clear scale separation from the regular subtitle and information. Numerals and range punctuation are readable.

typography.location: white band hours, fee and URL
typography.observation: All visitor details remain clear on the plain white field. The full URL occupies one uninterrupted line, with stable word spaces and punctuation.
The dominant title is legible while smaller details shrink considerably; this is a thumbnail limitation, not an observed glyph loss.

space.observation: The shared left margin and stepped gaps group title/subtitle, dates/venue, hours/fee and the URL. The text fits with a lower margin before the bottom photograph instead of running into it.

space.location: two image-band boundaries and hardware crops
space.observation: The top and bottom photographs balance roughly similar occupied heights around the information band. Both retain the mounting plates and object bodies, so the close crop remains purposeful even though the band hides the intervening door area.

image_material.location: top lever, especially the broad front grip and upper bright edge
image_material.observation: Metal machining, fine scratches and uneven rubbed sheen remain distinct at close scale. The rose, neck and lever have consistent form and softly modeled reflections; wear is localized to a believable contact surface.

image_material.location: bottom key face, head opening, shaft and cylinder
image_material.observation: The scuffed key face, bevel/thickness around its hole, parallel shaft grooves and circular cylinder form a convincing assembly. The gray painted door and soft shadows provide an appropriate restrained photographic setting.

emotion_control.location: top and bottom softly lit monochrome photographs
emotion_control.observation: Large, plain, used modern hardware invites a tactile reading of wear. The light background and soft transitions convey quiet familiarity rather than fear or the glamour of an antique sale.

emotion_control.location: whole poster with central museum-information band
emotion_control.observation: The modest information treatment and close attention to ordinary contact surfaces give an appropriate small-museum tone. No invented lore, sinister prop or sales apparatus is visible.

ai_slop.location: upper lever joint and lower key/cylinder joint
ai_slop.observation: The lever joins its mounting rose coherently, and the key shaft visibly enters the cylinder. The key-head hole follows the metal thickness and viewing angle; no floating or contradictory hardware connection is observed.
The copy has no extraneous labels, artifact numbers or logos. Surface detail follows the metal and door materials instead of appearing as unrelated ornaments or arbitrary texture patches.

residuals: native, central band: it conceals the continuous door area between the two details, so M1 supplies stronger uninterrupted spatial context.
native, whole composition: the three-band information layout is clear and refined but conventional rather than an exceptional formal invention.
thumbnail320, center: fine visitor copy becomes small, while the one-line title and both object forms remain legible.

evidence.location: whole composition, especially full door field and left column
evidence.observation: An uninterrupted photographic door carries overlaid left-aligned copy, with an upper handle and middle-right inserted key. Compared with M2 it removes the hands and changes medium; compared with M3 it preserves continuous environmental space instead of separating two close details with a white band.

evidence.location: upper grasp, lower-right hand/key and large middle title
evidence.observation: A high-contrast outlined illustration introduces two actual hand/object contacts, a strong right vertical door edge and a larger two-line title. This changes the represented action and graphic construction, rather than applying a different filter to the photographs.

evidence.location: top and bottom close images around central white strip
evidence.observation: Two enlarged hardware details surround a white information band and a one-line title. This gives more surface inspection and a distinct three-band silhouette relative to M1's continuous photograph and M2's human-use drawing.

residuals: All three retain a lever-above/key-below door grammar, a monochrome palette and heavy sans-serif title. The change in action, medium, object scale and information arrangement supports strong diversity, but the set does not warrant the exceptional-refinement anchor of 5.
M1 and M3 are the closest pair in subject and photographic material; their continuous-door versus separated-macro organization is the main distinction.
